name: Rolling-anchor ORB control — breakout WITHOUT the session anchor (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM/ROLE: this is the deliberate CONTROL for the session-handoff family. It runs the identical opening-range breakout with anchor='rolling' (a rolling trailing range, no US-session timing) gated by the same adx trend filter and positive ret_Nd. Economically it tests the pure breakout-continuation mechanism stripped of any regional-flow-handoff timing: momentum algos and stop-runs trigger a cascade when price clears a recent range, independent of the clock. DISCONFIRMER built into the cohort: if this rolling control nets the SAME as the session-anchored variants, the 'session' timing carried nothing and those variants are curve-fit; if this control dies while the session variants live, the handoff timing is the real edge. Either way it must itself clear DSR 0.95 net of fees to count as a standalone edge — a rolling breakout that only survives via best-of-N tuning is a fee-churning trap.
catalyst: price breaking a rolling recent range in a confirmed trend
